curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show where restrictions appear, why vision results cause most of them, the B, F and G vision-related restrictions, and how examiners handle disability restrictions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per restriction; contrast cards for glasses versus mirrors versus daylight only.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a described restriction requires of the driver.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the code chart: endorsements on licenses and ID cards, letter restriction codes, and number codes that mean different things as restrictions and endorsements.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Code-to-meaning cards; contrast cards for letters and numbers that appear twice on the chart.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on matching a code to its meaning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the motorcycle permit requirements and limits, its validity and renewal cap, then the routes to an endorsement, new-resident transfers and renewal.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for permit limits, validity and the endorsement routes; contrast cards for first-time riders versus new residents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a described rider needs to ride legally.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define the autocycle and its credential and riding rules, then define the MDC, its credential, age and gear rules, and where and how fast it may be ridden.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Definition and rule cards; contrast cards for autocycle versus MDC credentials, seating and age rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which credential and riding rules fit a described small vehicle.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what for-hire covers and excludes, who can get the endorsement and which exams apply, renewal timing, and the transport that does not count as for-hire.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the weight and passenger thresholds, eligibility and exclusions; contrast card for the motorcycle versus for-hire renewal windows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described job needs the for-hire endorsement.

one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
